title: Pressure Scale 1–5
summary: A simple scale describes intensity from barely perceptible contact to pronounced pressure.
goal: Make pressure easier to understand across cards.
startingPosition: Agree beforehand that pain is not the goal of massage.
instructions: 4/5 — pronounced pressure only when appropriate and comfortable.
5/5 — not used as a routine target in this home guide.
tips: Uncertainty is enough reason to reduce intensity or postpone massage.
Safety takes priority over completing a plan.
mistakes: Trying to continue at any cost.
Making overly confident conclusions without professional assessment.
warning: This guide is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis or individualized professional advice.
